Entries.BlackLicorice_Description: O‘tkir va kuchli ta’mli chaynaladigan konfet.
Entries.CappuccinoMousseCake_Description: Kapuchino mussi bilan qoplangan kichik shokoladli tort.
Entries.ChocolatePopcorn_Description: Oddiy popkorn... faqat usti shokolad bilan qoplangan.
Entries.CottonCandy_Description: Yigirilib tayyorlangan shakarning katta pushti buluti.
Entries.Fries_Description: Yupqa kesilib, qizdirilgan yog‘da qovurilgan va ozgina tuzlangan kartoshka.
Entries.IceCreamSandwich_Description: Ikki shokoladli pechenye orasidagi vanilli muzqaymoq.
Entries.JasmineTea_Description: Xushbo‘y yasmin gullari ta’mi berilgan ko‘k choy.
Entries.Jawbreaker_Description: Butun film davomiga yetadigan katta va qattiq konfet!
Entries.JojaCola_Description: Jojaning asosiy gazli ichimligidan o‘ta katta stakan.
Entries.JojaCorn_Description: Jojaning patentlangan makkajo‘xori taomi, mo‘l-ko‘l «sariyog‘ sousi»ga belangan.
Entries.Nachos_Description: Yangi qovurilgan tortilya chipslari ustidagi eruvchan achchiq pishloq.
Entries.PanzanellaSalad_Description: Non va pomidordan tayyorlangan yozgi salat.
Entries.PersonalPizza_Description: Gazak sifatida yeyish uchun yetarlicha kichik pitsa.
Entries.Popcorn_Description: Ozroq tuz sepilib, sariyog‘ quyilgan ochilgan makkajo‘xori donlari.
Entries.RockCandy_Description: Qulay tayoqchaga yopishgan ta’mli shakar kristallari.
Entries.SalmonBurger_Description: Yengil qovurilgan kunjutli bulochka orasidagi qalin losos bo‘lagi.
Entries.SourSlimes_Description: Turli rangdagi mayda marmelad shilimshiqlar. Ustiga o‘ta nordon kukun sepilgan.
Entries.StarCookie_Description: Kamalakrang sepma bilan bezatilgan yulduz shaklidagi qumoq pechenye.
Entries.StardropSorbet_Description: Bir tomchi Yulduz tomchisi essensiyasi bu sorbetni g‘ayrioddiy tansiq taomga aylantiradi.
Entries.TrufflePopcorn_Description: Tryufel tuzi sepilgan qadimiy navli popkorn.
